title: Section formula for strict quotient point transport
statement: For D,l,E and an arbitrary integral coefficient complex P as in [def-trf-point-transport-strict-quotient-models], every n>=0, integer degree i and section x of P_n^i at the final point object U satisfies u_n(P)^i(x) = res_(comma arrow)(gen_(g_n^*P_n)(res_(Frobenius restriction)(x))). Here gen is the prescribed pullback adjunction-unit insertion, and all restrictions and generators are the fixed maps of [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison] and [def-weil-frobenius-point-transport]. This identifies the actual integral-linear chain map, including the published scalar-restriction comparisons.

proof.text: The scalar-restriction comparison is identity on sections in each degree. Its inverse is also identity, by the inverse identity. Evaluate the composite defining u_n, apply the finite sigma restriction formula, and then the prescribed kappa insertion formula. All formulas are for the chosen maps, so equality is strict before localization.

theorem strictQuotientPointMap_sections (n : ℕ)
    (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E (Spec (.of D.k))) ℤ)
    (i : ℤ)
    (x : (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E (Spec (.of D.k)) n).obj P).X i).val.obj
      (op (ProEt.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of D.k)))))) :
    (strictQuotientPointMap D l E n P).f i x =
      (((integralOperationsPullbackLevel l E (frobeniusPointIso D).hom n).obj P).X i).val.map
        (proEtaleIsoCommaArrow (frobeniusPointIso D).hom
          (ProEt.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of D.k))))).op
        (integralOperationsPullbackGenerator l E (frobeniusPointIso D).hom n
          (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E (Spec (.of D.k)) n).obj P).X i)
          ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose (frobeniusPointIso D).hom).obj
            (ProEt.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of D.k)))))
          ((((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E (Spec (.of D.k)) n).obj P).X i).val.map
            (frobeniusPointRestriction D).op x))
